name: tolmach-subscription-proxy
description: Metering operator-proxy backend for the Tolmach Subscription tier. Zero runtime dependencies (Node built-in fetch/http/crypto). Sovereign tier needs no server; this backend exists only for the flat-monthly Subscription tier where tokens bill to the operator's Anthropic contract.

scripts.check: node --check server/proxy.mjs && node --check tools/metering-check.mjs && node --check tools/proxy-smoke.mjs && node --check tools/quota-test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke
